tts_lines: Incline dumbbell press. Flared elbows jam the front of your shoulder joint.
Tuck your elbows to forty-five degrees and pin your shoulder blades.
Flared elbows also dump the load onto your front delts.
At forty-five degrees the load moves onto your upper chest.

caption.title: Your incline press is hitting your shoulders, not your upper chest.
caption.question: Where do you feel your incline press most, chest or shoulders?
caption.save: Save this for your next chest day.
